sources.title: PostgreSQL EXPLAIN
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 查詢最佳化：選擇性相依與估計誤差
related.titleEn: Query optimization: correlated predicates and estimation error
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用小表建 hash 與大表 probe，分析容量不足時為何需要分割。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Build a hash table on the small relation and probe with the large one,then analyze capacity-driven partitioning. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 設計完全相關的城市與郵遞區號，展示獨立性假設如何低估列數。
related.differenceEn: Construct perfectly correlated city/postal attributes to expose independence-estimation errors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Hash join 依 join key 配對；重複鍵保留所有匹配，記憶體成本取決於 build 端及 overhead。 教學基準：50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes；第二檢核：ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
估計 P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B) 需要獨立；資料相關時聯合統計比各欄邊際更重要。 教學基準：10000*0.1*0.1 = 100 independent estimated rows；第二檢核：1000/100 = 10 underestimate factor。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Hash joins match join keys and preserve duplicates; memory depends on the build side and overhead. Teaching baseline: 50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes; second check: ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Estimating P(A and B)=P(A)P(B) assumes independence; correlated data needs joint information. Teaching baseline: 10000*0.1*0.1 = 100 independent estimated rows; second check: 1000/100 = 10 underestimate factor. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ZooKeeper：session、ephemeral 節點與 fencing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：用小表建 hash 與大表 probe，分析容量不足時為何需要分割。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。

Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 描述持鎖程序暫停後 session 過期，再恢復時如何阻止過期寫入。
related.differenceEn: Model a paused holder whose session expires and show how to reject stale writes after it resumes.

related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

Ephemeral 節點跟隨 session 生命周期；外部資源若只看鎖存在仍可能接受過期持有者，需驗 fencing token。 教學基準：42-41 = 1 token advancement；第二檢核：max(41,42) = 42 minimum current accepted token。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。

Teaching baseline: 50000*(32+24) = 2800000 modeled hash bytes; second check: ceil(2800000/(2*1024*1024)) = 2 ideal capacity partitions. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Ephemerals follow session lifetimes; external resources can still accept a stale holder unless they check fencing tokens. Teaching baseline: 42-41 = 1 token advancement; second check: max(41,42) = 42 minimum current accepted token. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
